findings.description: The implementation calls sleep(base_delay * 2 ** attempt) unconditionally on every TransientError, including the last attempt. According to the specification, no sleep should occur after the final failed call; the last TransientError must be re-raised immediately. This causes an unnecessary delay and does not conform to the required exponential backoff behavior.
findings.evidence: Line 12: sleep(base_delay * 2 ** attempt) is executed even when attempt == attempts - 1.

review.summary: Candidate sleeps after the final TransientError, violating the contract that no sleep should occur after the last failed attempt.
